acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a running service, the health action returns status ok.

approved_product_decisions.decision: Synthetic fixture issuance only; this is not product-owner approval.

desired_outcome: An operator can verify that the service is alive with one call.

functional_requirements.description: The local service reports an OK health status.
functional_requirements.title: Report service health

golden_cases: A running service returns status ok.
guardrails: No network or deployment action occurs during contract authoring.

known_risks.description: A process health check does not prove external dependency health.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: The local health result is deterministic.

north_star_metric: Percentage of service checks that correctly identify availability.
problem: Operators need a deterministic heartbeat before relying on a service.
